title: HtmlMark
responsibility: Renders the native mark element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlMark.attributes
inputs.description: Native mark attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlMark.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native mark element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlMark
outputs.description: The actual native mark element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
